question: How do first-time workspace admins make sense of initial setup?

codebook.name: Unclear next step
codebook.definition: The participant describes not knowing which action the product expected of them next.

include.text: Says they did not know what to do next or where to go
Describes searching the interface for the next action

exclude.text: Knew the next step but could not take it for lack of access (use ACCESS)
General comment on design with no moment of not knowing

codebook.name: Waiting on access
codebook.definition: Setup pauses because the participant needs another person to grant a right or approval.

include.text: Names a person or team they had to wait for
Describes a request for rights, licences or approval

exclude.text: Has the rights but cannot find the setting (use NEXT)

codebook.name: Stuck
codebook.definition: The participant describes not knowing which action the product expected of them next or where to go.

transcript.speaker: INT
transcript.text: Can you both walk me through the first hour after you created the workspace?

transcript.speaker: P1
transcript.text: The welcome screen was nice, but once it closed I was on an empty dashboard and I just did not know where to go. I clicked around the left menu for a while looking for something that said setup.

transcript.speaker: P2
transcript.text: For me it was the user import. I knew exactly where it was, the button was greyed out, and I had to wait two days for our IT team to give me the admin licence.

transcript.speaker: INT
transcript.text: What did you do in those two days?

transcript.speaker: P2
transcript.text: I kept a spreadsheet of everyone who needed an account and pasted the emails in one by one once the licence came through. There is a bulk upload somewhere but I never found it.

transcript.speaker: P1
transcript.text: Honestly the thing that unblocked me was sitting next to Dana from finance, who had set up her team the month before. I watched her do it and copied her settings.

transcript.speaker: INT
transcript.text: Did you look at the help centre at any point?

transcript.speaker: P1
transcript.text: I opened it once. The articles assume you already know what a space and a project are, so it did not help much at that stage.

transcript.speaker: P2
transcript.text: I raised a ticket with the vendor about the permissions page and they answered the same day, which was good.

transcript.speaker: P1
transcript.text: Looking back it all makes sense now. It is just that first hour.
